name: com.sharednc/suche
title: shareDnC Bürosuche
description: Find offices, coworking desks, day passes and meeting rooms for rent in Germany.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Checks that the shareDnC server is reachable. Returns "pong".

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description:
Search published office listings on shareDnC in one German city: private offices, coworking
desks, office floors, day passes, meeting rooms and virtual offices. Returns at most 20
listings with title, district, price, what the price covers (price_for, e.g. "für 4 Personen"),
whether VAT comes on top (price_note),
free places, a photo and a link to the listing on sharednc.com.
There is no paging: the 20 are the top of shareDnC's ranking out of total_matches. For others,
narrow the filters (districts, categories, budget) or link search_url, the same search with
all filters on sharednc.com.
Give the city name in German (e.g. "München", "Köln") or a postcode. Prices are in EUR.

city.description: German city name ("Berlin", "München") or a 5-digit postcode.

districts.description: Optional districts (Stadtteile) of that city, e.g. ["Mitte", "Kreuzberg"].

categories.description: Kinds of space. private_office = own office room, desk = coworking/fixed desk, office_area = whole office floor, day_pass = day ticket, meeting_room, virtual_office = business address. Several = any of them.

people.description: Number of people who need a place.

min_price.description: Minimum price in EUR, same unit as the listing prices (usually per month).

max_price.description: Maximum price in EUR, same unit as the listing prices (usually per month).

amenities.description: Required amenities; every listing has all of them.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description:
Get the details of one office listing on shareDnC by its id (from search_listings): description,
district and street, amenities, surroundings, photos and every available unit with type,
price, area, capacity, availability, minimum term, notice period and deposit.
Contact details of the provider are never included — enquiries are sent on sharednc.com.

id.description: Listing id as returned by search_listings.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description:
Compare 2 to 5 office listings on shareDnC by their ids (from search_listings): for each one the
district, the lowest monthly price and every available unit with id, type, price (price_note: VAT
and utilities), area, capacity,
availability, minimum term, notice period and deposit, plus amenities and the link.
Listings that are no longer available come back with available = false.
Contact details of the provider are never included.

ids.description: 2 to 5 listing ids as returned by search_listings.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description:
Market overview of office prices in one German city on shareDnC: number of listings and, for
coworking desks (price per desk and month) and private offices (price per office and month),
the lower quartile, median and upper quartile of all available units.
Use it to judge whether a price is cheap or expensive, or to tell the user what to budget.
Cities with fewer than 10 listings have no overview. Give the city name in German or a postcode.

city.description: German city name ("Berlin", "München") or a 5-digit postcode.

tools.name: start_enquiry
tools.description:
Get the link where the user can send an enquiry for a listing on sharednc.com, optionally with
units preselected (unit ids from get_listing). This does NOT send anything: show the link and
tell the user to open it and send the enquiry there themselves.

listing_id.description: Listing id from search_listings or get_listing.

unit_ids.description: Optional unit ids from get_listing to preselect.

type.description: Optional unit type to show first (same values as the unit "type" in get_listing).
